name: Recommerce by Budna
tagline: Compare listings and plan purchases, kits and pickup
description: Six portable Recommerce skills for comparing marketplace listings and preparing a purchase: Buy compares suitable listings and complete costs; Kits plans compatible setups within one budget; Inspect prepares item-specific checks; Collect assesses transport and access; Keep compares repair with replacement; and Second Look reassesses an earlier recommendation. The skills separate seller claims from verified evidence and unresolved condition. They do not contact sellers, reserve items, bid, or purchase.

install.notes: Select the skills you want in the installer. Each skill works with supplied evidence and available read-only tools; Budna MCP is optional and installed separately.
